TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE ACT 2016

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE

(DESIGNATION OF PRACTITIONER BODY) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 42(1) of the

Traditional and Complementary Medicine Act 2016 [Act 775], the Minister, on the

recommendation of the Council, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Traditional and Complementary

Medicine (Designation of Practitioner Body) Order 2020.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 August 2017.

Designation of practitioner body

2. The Minister designates the practitioner bodies specified in column (1) of the

Schedule as the designated practitioner bodies for the recognized practice areas

specified in column (2).
